scope: Theorem 1.2 of the manuscript “The p-adic section conjecture” (preprints/The-p-adic-section-conjecture-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 019 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f3c8d6f784d6bae4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let p be a prime, let k/Qp be finite, and let X/k be a smooth proper geometrically connected curve of genus at least two. Put K = k(X), choose a separable closure Ksep, and let f K ⊂ Ksep be the compositum of the function fields of all connected finite étale covers of X, with all their K-embeddings. For every real-valued rank-one norm on K extending the normalized p-adic norm on k, and every prolongation to Ksep, set E = [ Ksep, H = c f K ⊂ E, where the completions use that fixed prolongation. Then the specified subfield Ksep of E is contained in H.
